# Temple Scroll Column 21 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 21 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**21:1** You shall construct an altar of burnt offering from acacia wood: five cubits in length, five cubits in width — it shall be square — and three cubits in height.

**21:2** You shall fashion its horns on its four corners, the horns being of one piece with it, and you shall overlay it with copper.

**21:3** You shall make its pots for the removal of ashes, its shovels, its basins, its flesh-hooks, and its fire-pans. All its utensils you shall make of copper.

**21:4** You shall make for it a grating of copper network, and upon the network you shall make four copper rings at its four corners.

**21:5** You shall place it beneath the rim of the altar, below, so that the network extends to the midpoint of the altar.

**21:6** You shall make carrying-poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with copper.

**21:7** The poles shall be passed through the rings, so that the poles are on the two sides of the altar when it is carried.

**21:8** You shall make it hollow, of planks. As I revealed to you on the mountain, so shall they construct it.

**21:9** You shall overlay it with pure copper — its top, its sides on every side, and its horns — and you shall make for it a rim of gold all around.

**21:10** The altar shall be most holy to Me; whatever touches the altar shall become consecrated.

**21:11** You shall construct a ramp leading to the altar on its southern side. You shall not ascend by steps to My altar, lest your nakedness be exposed upon it.

**21:12** The ramp shall be sixteen cubits in length and ten cubits in width, ascending from the south.

**21:13** You shall position the altar before the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and you shall set the ramp to the south.

**21:14** Between the altar and the house you shall maintain a distance of twenty cubits on every side.

**21:15** No unauthorized person who is not of the lineage of Aaron shall draw near to offer fragrant incense before Me upon the altar.

**21:16** No one shall approach it who has not been consecrated and vested in the sacred garments; it shall be holy, most holy.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 21 well preserved. The altar specifications parallel Exodus 27:1-8 but are recast in divine first person per the Temple Scroll's characteristic reformulation. "Stranger" (zar) rendered "unauthorized person" to convey priestly-access restriction.*
